author: reek
body: The same quotation codex/test/quotes-gate.codex proves through the offered-works blob, proven here through the fact store instead. There is no %%QUOTED-WORKS%% section: the work is not beside the source. It is a signed, content-addressed fact on the disk this source is compiled against, written there by codex/test/apps/store-quoted-work. The compiler reads the store, finds the work by the digest quoted above, checks it through the same four guards, and only then is sort-ascending a name this chapter may use. This is the founding document's "delete GitHub" reduced to one program: the source of a quotation lives in the repository, not in a file handed alongside.
